en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone lane lined with shuttered houses and several people in early 20th‑century dress. The street curves up toward a large tree marking the entrance to a public garden. Caption at the top reads in French that it is the entrance to the public garden in Cassel. The reverse has French "Carte Postale" layout, a red French stamp, a French postmark, and an address written to Malmö, Sweden, with a long handwritten message in French.
